KerriganRavageSiphoningImpact.name: Siphoning Impact
KerriganRavageSiphoningImpact.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants 100 (+4% per level) points of Assimilation Shields.

KerriganAssimilationMastery.name: Assimilation Mastery
KerriganAssimilationMastery.description: Regeneration Globe healing grants 50 (+4% per level) points of Assimilation Shields per second while active. While Assimilation is active, Kerrigan's Health and Mana regeneration is increased by 150%.

KerriganFuryOfTheSwarm.name: Fury of the Swarm
KerriganFuryOfTheSwarm.description: Gain 10% more Assimilation Shields from Basic Attacks. After casting Ravage, Kerrigan's next Basic Attack within 3 seconds splashes for 100% damage around the target.

KerriganRavageSharpenedBlades.name: Sharpened Blades
KerriganRavageSharpenedBlades.description: Quest: Minions and Heroes that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Ravage increase its damage up to a maximum of 75. Minions grant 1 increased damage and Heroes grant 5 increased damage. Reward: After reaching a 75 damage increase, Ravage gains 50 additional damage.

KerriganImpalingBladesKineticFulmination.name: Kinetic Fulmination
KerriganImpalingBladesKineticFulmination.description: Damaging an enemy increases the damage of Kerrigan's next Impaling Blades within 10 seconds by 10%, up to 100%.

KerriganPrimalGraspPsionicPulse.name: Psionic Pulse
KerriganPrimalGraspPsionicPulse.description: Primal Grasp explodes a second time 2 seconds after its first explosion.

KerriganRavageQueenOfBlades.name: Queen of Blades
KerriganRavageQueenOfBlades.description: Reduce the cooldown of Ravage by 3 seconds and increase its damage to Minions and Mercenaries by 100%.

KerriganRavageBoundlessFury.name: Boundless Fury
KerriganRavageBoundlessFury.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Ravage grants a charge of Ravage. Can only occur once every 10 seconds per Hero.

KerriganBladedMomentum.name: Bladed Momentum
KerriganBladedMomentum.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Kerrigan's Basic Abilities by 0.6 seconds.

KerriganHeroicAbilityMaelstrom.name: Maelstrom
KerriganHeroicAbilityMaelstrom.description: Deals 74 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

KerriganHeroicAbilitySummonUltralisk.name: Summon Ultralisk
KerriganHeroicAbilitySummonUltralisk.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarge

KerriganPrimalGraspPsionicBarrier.name: Psionic Barrier
KerriganPrimalGraspPsionicBarrier.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Primal Grasp grants 20 Spell Armor and 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20% Movement Speed.

KerriganAssimilationVolatilePower.name: Volatile Power
KerriganAssimilationVolatilePower.description: Increase the amount of Assimilation Shields granted from damage dealt by 10%, but reduce duration of Assimilation by 3 seconds.

KerriganChrysalis.name: Chrysalis
KerriganChrysalis.description: Activate to place Kerrigan in a Chrysalis with 750 (+4% per level) Health for 5 seconds. While inside, Kerrigan regenerates 5% of her maximum Health per second. Enemies can destroy the Chrysalis to end its effects early.

KerriganRavageMountingPotency.name: Mounting Potency
KerriganRavageMountingPotency.description: Ravage grants 5% Spell Power for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

KerriganImpalingBladesPainfulSpikes.name: Painful Spikes
KerriganImpalingBladesPainfulSpikes.description: Enemies hit by Impaling Blades take an additional 70 (+4% per level) damage the next 6 times Kerrigan damages them within 5 seconds.

KerriganUnbridledEnergy.name: Unbridled Energy
KerriganUnbridledEnergy.description: Damaging a Hero with a Heroic Ability grants 35% Spell Power for 4 seconds.

KerriganOmegastormMaelstrom.name: Omegastorm
KerriganOmegastormMaelstrom.description: Maelstrom's duration is increased by 0.25 seconds every time it damages a Hero.

KerriganTorrasqueSummonUltralisk.name: Torrasque
KerriganTorrasqueSummonUltralisk.description: Increase the Health and Basic Attack damage of the Ultralisk by 20%. The Ultralisk morphs into an egg when it dies. If the egg isn't killed within 4 seconds, a new Ultralisk is born.

KerriganAssimilationAssimilationBlades.name: Assimilation Blades
KerriganAssimilationAssimilationBlades.description: Damaging an enemy increases Basic Attack damage by 2% for 5 seconds, up to 40%.

KerriganPsionicShift.name: Psionic Shift
KerriganPsionicShift.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Generates 300% increased Assimilation Shields from the damage dealt.
